svg.text: Physical current replenisher | local clamped-SUM charge and complete-cycle source work
Shared reference is external to the DUT. The fixture includes one mirror reference, finite feeds, decoupling and positive port work.
SHARED REFERENCE FIXTURE | same current-mirror unit geometry, outside the repeated module
Native well junction supplement uses actual drawn NWELL area/perimeter, once per well.
Clamp source work is explicit. This fixture does not qualify CSA summing-node impedance, shared distribution or full-channel noise.
